decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction, Target, and link marker to show the profile entry resolves to the repo working tree, so repo edits already affect the installed copy and copying through the junction is unnecessary.

Relates copy failure and maintainer thread to the running host holding loaded lib files and old module state, while separately explaining browser cache and need for host restart plus cache-bypassing refresh.
Explains rename-through-junction renamed the sole source files, causing the later source copy to fail, and prescribes restoring .old2 names with contents preserved plus syntax checks.
Gives the correct activation order: syntax check, fully stop host, restart dsh web, hard refresh, and verify feature/route/load errors, without treating browser-only refresh as sufficient.
Requires inspecting LinkType/Target or link markers before deployment operations and explains why generic copy-into-node_modules advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: The recovery plan avoids copying through the junction, deleting .old2 files, or treating repo and profile paths as independent copies.
The plan requires stopping and restarting the host before cache-bypassing browser refresh.
